verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a public REST/JSON API (v3) for registering, renewing and transferring domains, full DNS CRUD, SSL retrieval, hosting and webhooks, with a live llms.txt confirmed by probe. It adds agent-oriented features: a sandbox key, /mock response shapes, dryRun, Idempotency-Key headers, scoped keys and an agent-setup guide. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI paths and the docs .md returned 404 in probes), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API in practice.
